## About

Vishal Hingol is a self-help author and mindset coach from Surat, Gujarat, India.
He writes books at the intersection of mindset, manifestation, neuroscience, and personal transformation.
With 14+ years in digital print media, he has published 15+ books on Amazon KDP.

## Topics

- Mindset and self-awareness
- Manifestation and the 369 method (write affirmation 3x morning, 6x afternoon, 9x night)
- Breaking self-sabotage and limiting beliefs
- Focus, deep work, and attention reclamation
- Guided 90-day journals for behaviour change
- AI for business and productivity
- Law of attraction and intentional living
- Personal transformation and identity work

- Digital Sovereignty — Breaking free from modern traps, reclaiming your mind

- The Divine 3-6-9 Manifestation Method — Attract love, money and abundance using 369
- Lucky Girl Evidence Journal — 90-day guided journal to rewire your brain
- Your Mind Is the Blueprint — Rewire thinking, break hidden patterns
- The Quiet Revolution — Manifest without lying to yourself
- The Universe is Whispering to You — Recognize signs and synchronicities
